patterns.diagnosis: The workflow pins actions/upload-artifact or download-artifact v1-v3, which GitHub retired. The job is failed during 'Set up job' before any step runs.
patterns.fix: Change the action to actions/upload-artifact@v4 (or download-artifact@v4). v4 artifacts are immutable, so give each upload a unique name.
patterns.example: ##[error]This request has been automatically failed because it uses a deprecated version of `actions/upload-artifact: v3`.

patterns.match: (Could not open requirements file|No such file or directory: '?requirements\.txt)
patterns.diagnosis: The workflow installs from requirements.txt, but the file is not in the repository.
patterns.fix: Commit the requirements file, or remove the install step if the code uses only the standard library.
patterns.example: ERROR: Could not open requirements file: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'requirements.txt'

patterns.diagnosis: flake8 reported style or correctness violations, so the lint step exits 1 and the tests never run.
patterns.fix: Run `flake8 .` locally and fix each reported line. Do not widen the ignore list to hide F-codes (real bugs such as unused imports and undefined names).

patterns.diagnosis: The workflow pushes a branch or opens a PR, but its GITHUB_TOKEN is read-only.
patterns.fix: Add `permissions: {contents: write, pull-requests: write}` to the workflow. To open PRs, the owner must also allow 'GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests' under Settings > Actions > General.
patterns.example: remote: Permission to lippytm/AI-Time-Machines.git denied to github-actions[bot].

patterns.match: Dependency review is not supported on this repository
patterns.diagnosis: actions/dependency-review-action needs the repository's Dependency graph, which is turned off. Every PR fails this check, including Dependabot PRs.
patterns.fix: Owner setting, not code: Settings > Code security > enable 'Dependency graph' (free for public repositories). Do not delete the check to make CI green.
patterns.example: ##[error]Dependency review is not supported on this repository. Please ensure that Dependency graph is enabled

patterns.match: (GitHub returned HTTP 403|API rate limit exceeded|rate limit exhausted)
patterns.diagnosis: An unauthenticated GitHub API call ran on a shared Actions runner and hit the 60 requests/hour limit. Failures are intermittent.
patterns.fix: Send the job's read-only `${{ github.token }}` with the request (1,000 requests/hour per repository) and keep the job's permissions at contents: read.

patterns.diagnosis: A test or script imports a package that the CI install step did not install, or that was installed for a different interpreter.
patterns.fix: Add the package to the install step or project dependencies, and run tools as `python -m pytest` so they use the same interpreter as `pip`.

patterns.diagnosis: The pull request conflicts with its base branch.
patterns.fix: Rebase or merge the base branch into the PR branch and resolve the conflicts. If the PR is stale and superseded, close it with a note naming its replacement.

patterns.diagnosis: A step that writes to the GitHub API (most often codeql-action/upload-sarif) runs with a token that lacks the needed permission.
patterns.fix: Grant only the missing scope on that job, e.g. 'security-events: write' for SARIF uploads. Never switch the whole workflow to write-all.

patterns.diagnosis: A manifest under templates/ does not satisfy the template validator's schema.
patterns.fix: If the manifest is buildable, add the missing keys with real values. If it is design-only, mark it 'status: architecture_only' so it is checked against the architecture schema. Never add placeholder deployment fields.
